sources.title: Trial Classification | abundant-ai/taskgen | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This page documents the trial classification system, which uses Claude to analyze Harbor agent trial outcomes and categorize them into five distinct classifications. Trial classification distinguishes between task quality problems (BAD_SUCCESS, BAD_FAILURE) and agent capability problems (GOOD_FAILURE), enabling targeted improvements to the task dataset.
